checks.title: Samples shared across splits
checks.summary: 2 test records have an exact feature match in train.
checks.recommendation: Inspect these record pairs. If they represent the same observation, deduplicate before splitting. Identical features alone do not prove leakage.

checks.title: Repeated samples in train
checks.summary: 1 repeated feature record beyond the first occurrence.
checks.recommendation: Review repeated observations before splitting or evaluating. Repeated features can also be legitimate; do not delete them automatically.

checks.title: Repeated samples in test
checks.summary: 0 repeated feature records beyond the first occurrence.
checks.recommendation: Review repeated observations before splitting or evaluating. Repeated features can also be legitimate; do not delete them automatically.

checks.title: Entities shared across splits
checks.summary: 2 nonmissing entity IDs occur in both splits.
checks.recommendation: If evaluation must generalize to unseen entities, split by entity. Overlap may be appropriate for forecasting known entities. Missing IDs are unassessed.

checks.title: Strict future holdout
checks.summary: Train does not end strictly before test begins.
checks.recommendation: For a strictly future evaluation, put every training record before the first test timestamp. Ties are flagged. This check does not inspect feature availability.

checks.title: Target copied into a feature
checks.summary: 1 feature column exactly matches the target in every record.
checks.recommendation: Verify whether these columns are available at prediction time. Remove copies created from the outcome. Exact equality is a review signal, not a causal diagnosis.
